origin: Follow-up to outer-tool-usage-2026-10-17.json. Reviewed all three explicit Bash errors in that fixed three-file replay; original source tails recovered by exact hash without replaying commands.

cases.observedFailure: zsh rejected a wildcard with no matches during a compound metadata probe.
cases.finding: Caller shell expansion stopped the probe. A failure at this stage does not establish an MCP or command service fault.
cases.verification: Owned empty/one-file/missing/unreadable directory cases; scoped null-glob only when zero matches is valid.

cases.observedFailure: Inline Python accessed pong.params.agentPanel after sending only ping and raised KeyError(params).
cases.finding: The probe confused transport liveness with capability advertisement. Installed chrome-use returns bare pong for ping; hello advertises the capability schema.
cases.verification: Installed binary in owned Home/relay directory; only ping and hello frames; no CDP client, browser operation or agent/model request.

cases.observedFailure: Go compilation reported a missing parameter name in a verification script.
cases.finding: A caller-side build-stage failure. The examined current committed file passes syntax/format parsing; that does not establish a successful build or data verification.

shellMechanism.scope: Owned fixture directories only; allow-empty is appropriate only after confirming directory availability and that zero matches is valid.

nativeHostMechanism.scope: Installed native-host metadata framing only; no Chrome, browser page, agent/model task or live profile interaction.

scope: Three selected historical error records only; not evidence that all MCPs are healthy or that a tool with errors is poor.
changes: No product source, original logs or real browser/profile state was edited by this review. Only owned fixture files and current Thermo documentation were written. Existing error counters were preserved.
limitations: The original failing probe binary digest was not recorded; current installed-binary behavior is independently measured rather than assumed identical.
The current Go script received syntax/format parsing only; no build, verifier execution, database query or production acceptance.
Corrected probe mechanisms do not measure autonomous model recovery, task success rates or billed tokens.
